questions.def: 'It was' emphasizes who performed the action.
questions.question: It ___ Tom who broke the window.

questions.def: Singular verb 'is' agrees with the singular subject 'all I want'.
questions.question: All I want ___ a new bike.

questions.def: Use the base form of the verb after 'to'.
questions.question: What I want to ___ is the importance of education.

questions.def: 'That' introduces a defining relative clause.
questions.question: The thing ___ makes me happy is music.

questions.def: Past simple 'started' fits the past context.
questions.question: It ___ raining when I left home.

questions.def: Use the base form of the verb after 'must'.
questions.question: We must ___ the need for more resources.

questions.def: 'Now' emphasizes the current need.
questions.question: What I need ___ is some rest.

questions.def: Object pronoun 'him' is correct after 'was'.
questions.question: It was ___ that I saw yesterday.

questions.def: Use the base form of the verb after 'to'.
questions.question: I want to ___ the positive aspects.

questions.def: 'So' emphasizes the degree of importance.
questions.question: It is ___ important to be on time.

questions.def: Singular past tense verb 'was' agrees with 'what she said'.
questions.question: What she said ___ true.

questions.def: Use the base form of the verb after 'let'.
questions.question: Let me ___ the main points.

questions.def: 'Exactly' emphasizes the precision of the need.
questions.question: It was ___ that I needed.

questions.def: 'Is' agrees with the singular subject 'The reason'.
questions.question: The reason I am late ___ because of the traffic.

questions.def: Use the base form of the verb after 'to'.
questions.question: I want to ___ what I mean.

questions.def: 'What' introduces a noun clause acting as the subject.
questions.question: ___ is important is your health.

questions.def: 'Was' fits the past tense context.
questions.question: It ___ my brother who helped me.

questions.def: Use the base form of the verb after 'let'.
questions.question: Let me ___ out the key features.

questions.def: 'Quite' emphasizes the degree of surprise.
questions.question: It was ___ a surprise.

questions.def: 'Was' agrees with the singular subject 'the person'.
questions.question: The person who called ___ my sister.

questions.def: Use the base form of the verb after 'to'.
questions.question: I want to ___ something important.

questions.def: 'What' introduces a noun clause.
questions.question: ___ I need is a vacation.

questions.def: 'Was' shows it happened in the past.
questions.question: It ___ him I saw at the party.

questions.def: Focus structure: 'It was...who' emphasizes who did the action.
questions.question: It was Peter who ___ the window.

questions.def: Focus structure: 'All I want' takes a singular verb.
questions.question: All I want ___ a cup of tea.

questions.def: Focus structure: 'It was' not 'It were' is the correct form.
questions.question: It were my brother that called.

questions.def: Focus structure: auxiliary 'do' needed for questions.
questions.question: What ___ you want?

questions.def: 'What I need' acts as a singular subject.
questions.question: What I need ___ more time.

questions.def: Object pronoun 'her' needed after 'It was'.
questions.question: It was ___ car that hit the tree.

questions.def: 'All I asked for' functions as a singular subject.
questions.question: All I asked for ___ a simple answer.
